_comment: Paths whose changes never call for a manual update. DocBot drops them
before any model sees the merge request, and a merge that touches nothing
else ends there. Everything not listed goes to the model, which decides
which manual pages, if any, the change affects.
`code` entries are regexes matched against changed file paths as GitLab
reports them, repo-root-relative. Keep this list short: every entry is a
promise that a whole area can never matter to a reader of the manual.

ignore._comment: DocBot's own code. Changing the bot does not change the product.

_comment: The manual is DocBot's destination, never its trigger. Without this
entry a bot-authored merge request would trigger the next run.
docbot also skips merge requests labelled docbot-generated; this entry
covers what that label cannot, a human editing the manual by hand.
